rfam.comment: This family represents a Cripavirus internal ribosome entry site (IRES) which is required for the production of capsid proteins through IRES-mediated translation [1]. The Structure of IRES Cripavirus has being reported in PDB: 2IL9, 2NOQ, 4D5N, 4D61, 4V92, 4XEJ_AIRE, 4XEJ_BIRE, 5IT9, 7JQC, 6D90, 6D9J, 7ZJW, 7ZJX, 5IT7, 9G8M, 9G8O [2-10]
